name: Etrean Royalists
desc:
The Etrean Royalists, also known as the Old Guard, are a group of Etreans belonging to the various ancient clans that make up the Old Guard of [Etrea](faction:etrea) who were respected before [The Lord Regent](entity:the_lord_regent)'s coup, being now treated as 'a gaggle of rebellious lords, - or worse, 'scheming usurpers' thanks to the Regent's mind veil over the people of [Etris](location:etris). They appear exclusively in the Vow of Iron mode and are working alongside the [Circle of Honour](faction:circle_of_honour) to take down [The Lord Regent](entity:the_lord_regent).

The Royalists are made up of four distinct clans: Clan Anako, Clan Mofisu, Clan Kobura and Clan Ganba. They are all led by their respective 'Sachans' or Clan Leaders: Yi Anako, Choji Mofisu, Shisui Kobura and Zaru Ganba.

They are the primary enemy of [The Lord Regent](entity:the_lord_regent) and seek to free [Etrea](faction:etrea) from the mind veil he has imposed over its citizens. The Royalists during the Etrean Civil War used the [Temple of Mur](location:temple_of_mur) as a clandestine base of operations to plan their fight, however, it and the nearby [Viridian Sanctuary](location:viridian_sanctuary_ruins) were attacked by Shoguns sent by the Lord Regent effectively causing the Mofisu Clan to go into exile.

Following a heated argument between each of the Sachans at [The Golden Rat](location:the_golden_rat), the Old Guard was effectively disbanded leaving each clan alone to their own plans. Clan Ganba wished to make contact with the [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils) and use it as a base of operations against the Lord Regent, and if not possible, make their way westward and attempt to join with [The Hundred Legions](faction:the_hundred_legions). They also wished to retake the Monastery of Mur and the Viridian Sanctuary to which Clan Mofisu and Clan Anako were 'adamant' about.

On the other hand, Clan Kobura wanted to join forces with [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority) claiming they needed 'powerful allies against the Regent' or even join the Regent's forces if no other solution presented themselves.
additional_info:
-   During the very early start of Vow of Iron's release, the Royalists were always hostile against the players, making obtaining all Etris Flasks harder.
-   The Royalists seemingly are the only Etreans still capable of making the previously mentioned Etris Flasks seeing as they are only obtainable in their estates. This likely means their dissolution are what makes them not appear in Pathfinder.
-   The naming scheme of the Royalists are a play on various snake species, evidenced by the Styles of related equipment like the Etrean Sashimono. The list is as follows:
    -   Anako -> Anaconda
    -   Kobura -> Cobra
    -   Ganba -> Mamba
    -   Mofisu -> Psammophis
